# Project Governance

## 🎯 Mission Statement
The mission of this project is to provide a reliable, deterministic, and community-driven open-source solution.

---

## 🏛️ Decision-Making Process
Decisions are made by consensus among project maintainers. When consensus cannot be reached, proposals are escalated to the Core Maintainers for a final vote requiring a two-thirds majority.

### Proposals & RFCs
Major architectural changes, public API modifications, and breaking shifts require an RFC submitted under `docs/rfcs/`.

---

## 👥 Roles & Responsibilities

### Core Maintainers
- Maintain overall architecture, security posture, and release pipelines.
- Hold administrative access to repository secrets and package registry scopes.

### Maintainers
- Review, approve, and merge Pull Requests.
- Triage issues, manage project milestones, and guide new contributors.

### Contributors
- Submit bug fixes, feature improvements, documentation updates, and RFC proposals.

---

## 🪜 Maintainer Nomination
Active contributors who consistently demonstrate code quality, empathetic code reviews, and community engagement may be nominated as maintainers by an existing Core Maintainer.

---

## ⚖️ Conflict Resolution
If a technical dispute cannot be resolved through discussion within 14 days, the Core Maintainers hold a formal recorded vote.
